---
title: Quarto extensions
author: Mickaël Canouil
version: 1.0.0
format: mcanouil-revealjs
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    footer:
      right: version
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A deck with the version in the right footer slot turns the slide number off, with one warning, so nothing sits over the version.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the deck footer has no "page" in its right slot, so the slide number is off'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['slideNumber: false', '<span class="mc-slot mc-slot-right">1\.0\.0</span>']
        - ['mc-slot-page', "slideNumber: 'c/t'"]
---

## A slide

A paragraph.
